observer: Original Voynich image-side observer. Known-language selected-candidate visual check, not blind experiment, third independent expert, or historical identification of Voynich content.

method.coordinates: Original SAP image pixels, origin upper left, xyxy=[xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]. No resize/offset in reported coordinates. Approximate manual envelopes, normally 5–15 px uncertainty and larger at arcs/overlapping strokes.
method.input_exposure: Catalogue already identifies manuscript, language roles, twelve winds, and suggested name/description layers. These are exposed hypotheses, not unknown discoveries.
method.geometric_ids: f1v starts at actual top face and proceeds clockwise; f2r starts at actual upper vertical divider and inventories the cell immediately clockwise, then clockwise. No linguistic reading order claimed and no equal-angle slot interpolation.
method.visual_operations: Both whole originals viewed first; ten native crops/exact 90-degree rotations examined. No enhancement, repair, OCR or generated lines.
method.transcription: No label or description words recorded, compared or scored. Language names are catalogue-derived role names, not palaeographic certification.
method.independence: No current partner transcription/observation read or received before this report freeze. Previous urine-chart failures and Voynich/f67 word-boundary outputs untouched.
